charlieshort5.0: Silas Charlieshort came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Silas Charlieshort watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
drkevlagg: Day 8. The corporal put Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Asked what he will do after the war, Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg said: 'Be a butcher's boy in Dunmarrow. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
gothic_enthusiast: The new sapper is Anselm Enthusiast, once a brewer from Lindenbruck. The corporal asked if a brewer was any use in a trench. Anselm Enthusiast said he would find out.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Anselm Enthusiast helped stack spare sandbags at S-C14. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
hayden.dt: Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden introduced himself as a blacksmith from Rosenau. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
One of the first hundred, Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.
After what happened at the Brickworks, Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden asked to serve as a field cook. Nobody argued.
A crow sat on the parapet above Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden all afternoon. The men say it chose him.

Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Karel Check and Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.

A shell landed square in R-F10. They found Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. The shell that hit R-F10 took Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden with it. No stretcher, no surgeon, no last words. Just the crater.

Pavel "Crow" Hayden asked about Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden on arriving at R-F10. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. Pavel "Crow" Hayden answered the first call, number 73 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.

Pavel "Crow" Hayden crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at R-F10 holds again. Pavel "Crow" Hayden fired at a movement across the wire at R-F10. The man went down: Oskar Eddie, grazed. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Pavel "Crow" Hayden helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years. Pavel "Crow" Hayden became a signaller today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Pavel "Crow" Hayden and Teodor Roos argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. A letter from home found Pavel "Crow" Hayden before the night shift. Pavel "Crow" Hayden folded it small and kept it close.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F10 and grazed Pavel "Crow" Hayden's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Rafael "Button" Superfeisty of the Concord (@superfeisty7).
Pavel "Crow" Hayden's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-F10 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.

A bullet found Pavel "Crow" Hayden at R-F10, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Karel Pavla of the Concord (@pavla.9_). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Pavel "Crow" Hayden fell at R-F10 and never moved again. Shot by Karel Pavla of the Concord (@pavla.9_).

The House of Hayden sent Gideon Hayden after Pavel "Crow" Hayden. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. Gideon Hayden is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave. Gideon Hayden's transfer to the role of machine gunner was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

At R-F10 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Gideon Hayden turned around and took a shovel blow. Quentin Adams of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Quentin Adams of the Concord (@_smokey_adams_). Blackwater Canal has been won. Gideon Hayden listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch. A letter from home found Gideon Hayden before the night shift. Gideon Hayden folded it small and kept it close.
lemonade_lover393: The new rifleman is Bastian Lover, once a tailor from Greyhallow. The corporal asked if a tailor was any use in a trench. Bastian Lover said he would find out.
The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Bastian Lover folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
sam.ricks: Arno Ricks took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Arno Ricks of the Concord and Roland Theelliottma of the Hegemony have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at Hill 304. It is getting crowded.
Arno Ricks offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-S13, Arno Ricks listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
teamkaylin: On Day 9, Bastian Teamkaylin arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In T-F20, Bastian Teamkaylin listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
